Name: Dry Skin
Effect: While Sunny Weather is active, this Pokémon will receive 1 Damage at the end of each Round. Damaging Fire-Type attacks will deal 1 additional Damage to this Pokémon. When this Pokémon is hit by a Water-Type Move, you may restore 1 HP instead of receiving damage. Water-Type Moves do not deal damage to this Pokémon.
Description: The skin of this Pokémon needs special care as it is very dry and brittle, it'll require constant hydration and protection against the sun.
